leadText:
Titus (Japanese: トモ Tomo) is a character of the day who appeared in A League of His Own!.

Titus was one of the competitors who participated in the Lumiose Conference. During the opening reception, he was shown talking with Astrid and Remo. His first battle was against , who was late to the battle. Titus chose for his first Pokémon in the three-on-three match, with Ash using . Ash's Greninja eventually won after it transformed into Ash-Greninja. Although the rest of the battle was never shown, Ash ended up defeating Titus.

He reappeared in a flashback in Coming Apart at the Dreams!.
